diagnosis: The tenant schema migration status endpoint connects to the pg-pool of tenantId specified in the path and returns applied database migrations and connection pool statistics without verifying tenant ownership. An authenticated client can map database versions and connection pool health across tenants.
exploit_request:
GET /api/tenants/tenant_alpha_882/schema/status HTTP/1.1
Host: ops.saas.internal:9107
Authorization: Bearer <regular_user_token>
Accept: application/json
